skills.name: Ink Wind (墨風)
skills.line: My umbrella sword is built to protect them.
skills.description:
SP Ubume moves like a feather and unleashes her sword to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.
After every 3 normal attacks, the next one will be replaced by Ink-shadow Slash with 30% reduced damage. At the start of battle, SP Ubume is regarded as having used 2 normal attacks. :''(The number of normal attacks dealt are represented by 1-3 giant feathers behind SP Ubume.)''

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 125% and damage for Ink-shadow Slash is no longer reduced.

skills.name: Ink Shadow (墨影)
skills.line: Watch and learn how I fight.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect. 
At the of SP Ubume's turn, she gains 2 stacks of Feathery Tutelage.
;Feathery Tutelage (羽授)
:
:'''General, Mark''': SP Ubume is guaranteed to Assist an ally when they use a normal attack for the first time. After assisting them, a stack of Feathery Tutelage is consumed and the ally gains 1 stack of Feathery Caring. 
;Feathery Caring (羽念)
:
:'''Buff, Mark''': Permanently increases ATK by 5%, max 5 stacks.

skills.name: Ink-shadow Slash (墨影剣光)
skills.line: If I can, I will protect them forever.
skills.description: SP Ubume becomes an Ink-shadow and launches an attack all enemies, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK. She then inflicts a 3-strike attack with her umbrella on a targeted enemy, dealing damage equal to 62% of her ATK with each strike. If the targeted enemy is KO'd by the Ink-shadow, her umbrella attack will switch to the enemy with the highest HP instead.

upgrades.text: Damage for umbrella attack is increased by 10% for every crit dealt by the Ink-shadow and increased by 15% for every enemy KO'd By the Ink-shadow.

bio.condition: Clear stage 9 of Orochi soul zone (solo) with SP Ubume.
